# Nell Harcourt & Rosalind Penrose

- [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — Friend of — [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) — close friends who visit each other · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P31](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0031), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), +2 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to teaching school, where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) reports his classroom antics while [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde take a wrong turn while walking through the autumn woods to a tea invitation and discover [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where its owner, Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), invites them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> Miss Rosalind welcomes Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for tea at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and explains her solitary life, imaginative habits, and why her young helper is called Belinda the Fourth. When [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) Stanhope's name is mentioned, Miss Rosalind asks if he is [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) Stanhope's son before growing quiet and distant. As the girls walk away, they reflect on her loneliness and the meaning of names.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to spend a cozy winter night with Miss Rosalind, who shares the story of her long-ago engagement to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and the prideful misunderstanding that separated them. A month later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) brings Stephen's son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), to meet Miss Rosalind, and the two quickly bond during a pleasant visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde talk in bed at night about local gossip, the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and Nell's upcoming departure for [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). They discuss romance, Nell's feelings about Hugh, and Opal Pettigrew's behavior, concluding with a heartfelt reaffirmation of their deep and lasting friendship.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P41](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0041), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)_

> As Hugh walks with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to his buggy, they reflect on [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and Stanhope's reunion. Hugh's gentle words trigger a sudden awakening in [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), shifting her perspective from girlhood to womanhood as she recognizes deeper feelings within their companionship.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0037), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0039), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P41](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0041)_

> After recounting a story about losing and finding streetcar fare, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde visit [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) for a day outing. They open the house, reminisce about [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), test the echoes with an old horn, and head home after sunset.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P57](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0057), [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.Again P59](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0059), [v3 ch.Again P60](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0060)_
